statement.text:
Let G be a finitely generated branch group. Are all finite-index maximal
subgroups of G necessarily normal?
   Cf. 18.81.                                                          A. Thillaisundaram
  ∗ No, not necessarily (P. Neumann, Illinois J. Math., 30 (1986), 301–316). More-
over, there are finitely generated branch groups all of whose maximal subgroups are
of finite index but not all of them are normal (M. Garciarena, M. Petschick, Preprint,
2024, https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.06783).
